You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: The module is a minimal TLA+ specification, likely created as a test case or regression example related to GitHub issue 407. It models a simple monotonically growing set over a fixed data domain. The constant set `Data` contains two symbolic elements, `"d1"` and `"d2"`. The single variable `state` begins as the empty set and, on each step, grows by the addition of some element chosen nondeterministically from `Data`. Because elements are only ever added and never removed, `state` is always a subset of `Data`. The specification has no invariants, liveness properties, or fairness conditions defined; it is intended purely to exercise model-checking infrastructure rather than to verify meaningful system properties.
